segments.title: Chương 30: 0030【Đại hình Arubaya hầu hạ】
segments.content:
That night.

The last bus stopped by the side of the road, and Zheng Feng followed Bian Guanyue as she got off.

He escorted her all the way into the pitch-black alley, muttering to himself, "Why haven't they fixed the streetlights yet?"

Bian Guanyue said, "My grandpa spoke to the neighborhood office. They said they'll fix it once they have the money."

"It's just a matter of changing a few light bulbs. Dragging it out like this is ridiculous." Zheng Feng was very agitated tonight; nothing seemed right to him.

"Thank you," Bian Guanyue pointed at the building and said, "I'm going upstairs now."

Bian Guanyue wasn't an ungrateful person. She was quite thankful in her heart for Zheng Feng accompanying her to and from school every day and escorting her through the alley at night.

Because of this, she had started talking to Zheng Feng more.

But Zheng Feng didn't feel particularly happy about this change, because Bian Guanyue was much closer to Chen Guiliang.

"Wait!"

Zheng Feng called out to stop her. There were some things he had to get off his chest.

Bian Guanyue, who had almost reached the stairwell, turned around upon hearing him and asked, "What's wrong?"

Zheng Feng hesitated, "Chen Guiliang... is not a good student."

"How is he not a good student?" Bian Guanyue felt a little displeased.

Zheng Feng said, "He doesn't focus on his studies, he's always stirring up trouble, and he's been in several fights at school. If the head teacher hadn't pleaded for him, he would have been expelled long ago. He's still on probation right now."

Bian Guanyue asked, "Has he bullied any students?"

"He has... I think," Zheng Feng wasn't sure either.

Bian Guanyue stated solemnly, "Zheng Feng, we're friends, and so is Chen Guiliang. I think that between friends, if you have something to say, you should say it to their face. You shouldn't speak ill of people behind their backs."

Hearing the tone in her voice, Zheng Feng didn't dare to slander Chen Guiliang anymore and just mumbled, "I'm just afraid you'll be led astray by Chen Guiliang."

Bian Guanyue felt she should make things clear, "Zheng Feng, I know you have feelings for me, and I'm grateful that you walk me home every day. But we should be focusing on our studies and striving to get into a better university. When you get to university, you'll meet girls who are better than me."

Although these words were put very tactfully, the meaning was already crystal clear.

Zheng Feng stood frozen in place, his heart filled with grievance and despair. He couldn't understand how he was any worse than Chen Guiliang.

If nothing else, they were already in their third year of high school, and Chen Guiliang hadn't even joined the Youth League!

(Chen Guiliang: Are you going to pay my League fees for me?)

Bian Guanyue quickly ran home. Her grandparents were watching TV in the living room.

"Guanguan's back!"

Her grandpa immediately went to cut some fruit, while her grandma pulled her down to sit and talk.

There had been a parent-teacher conference during the day, and both Bian Guanyue and Chen Guiliang had been publicly criticized. Mainly because on Friday afternoon, they had left school without asking for leave in advance, and hadn't signed out at the gatehouse either.

From this, her grandparents also learned that a boy named Chen Guiliang had accompanied their granddaughter to the city to get her computer fixed.

And that this boy was already on probation at school.

The old couple really didn't know how to advise her, afraid that a single misstep would trigger their granddaughter's rebellious streak.

They had been putting it off and still hadn't brought it up.

Her grandpa came over with the fruit and blinked frantically at her grandma, meaning "You say it."

Her grandma hesitated for a long time, the words reaching her lips only to be swallowed back down.

Her grandpa had no choice but to take the lead himself, "Guanguan, you've been at the new school for a week. Have you made any new friends in class?"

Bian Guanyue said, "There's a girl named Wang Siyu who I get along with pretty well. Her family lives over in Fugui Gardens. There's also a male classmate named Zheng Feng. His home is only one stop away from here, so we often go to and from school together."

Her grandpa thought: Uh-oh, this is bad. She didn't mention that Chen Guiliang at all.

Her grandma followed up on the topic, "I know that young man, Zheng Feng. His grandma used to work at our cotton mill, and his grandpa was at the chemical fertilizer plant next door. Ai, both factories have closed down, and his parents became laid-off workers too."

Her grandpa commented, "His mom is very capable. When she was first laid-off, she shined shoes for people. Later, she set up a stall at the entrance of No. 7 Middle School selling cold noodles, liangpi, and wolf-tooth potatoes. I hear she's made quite a bit of money these past two years."

"His dad's not bad either. He didn't just drift along after being laid off. He switched careers to become a chef at forty," her grandma quickly joined the discussion.

Bian Guanyue wasn't interested in these things. She sat beside them, chiming in casually a few times, then picked up her schoolbag and went back to her bedroom to study.

She turned on her desk lamp and took out her pencil case and test papers.

As she unzipped the pencil case to get a pen, Bian Guanyue saw that broken stone again.

It was milky white, like a fine piece of jade.

A childish impulse struck her. She used a pen to draw eyes, a nose, and a mouth on the stone. After she was done, she even wrote "Simpleton" next to the little person.

You're done for! You've fallen in love!

Outside dorm room 302.

Several scoundrels exchanged glances, clearly having already planned some mischief.

Chen Guiliang was completely oblivious, whistling the tune of "Dong Feng Po" as he walked into the room.

"Get him!"

Xie Yang roared, and the rascals pounced at the same time.

Before Chen Guiliang could even react, he was pulled and pushed onto the bed by the crowd.

Xie Yang grabbed him by the neck, Xu Haibo and Liu Zhihong pinned down his left and right arms, while Li Yulin and Yang Cong held down his legs.

Li Dongqiang pulled off his belt, folded it in half, and snapped it, making a sharp cracking sound.

The introverted and timid Yang Hao stood by, smiling and watching the spectacle.

"Spill it! Are you and Bian Guanyue dating or not!" Xie Yang began the interrogation.

Li Dongqiang whipped the bed frame with his belt, threatening menacingly, "If you don't confess honestly, don't blame me for using enhanced interrogation techniques."

Xu Haibo also chimed in, shouting, "Leniency for those who confess, severity for those who resist!"

Chen Guiliang could only wail, "Sir, I've been wronged!"

"Still not confessing?"

Xie Yang let go of Chen Guiliang, tossed his hair back coolly, and stood to the side, directing, "Time for the ultimate torture!"

"Aluba! Aluba..."

The gang of scoundrels cheered and shouted in unison. They lifted Chen Guiliang, adjusted his position, and aimed his crotch at the bed frame, about to ram him into it.

Chen Guiliang cried out in terror, "F*ck! My dear grandsons, spare my life! Grandpa confesses!"

"Hurry up and talk, don't waste time," Xie Yang urged.

Chen Guiliang said, "No stir-fry for lunch tomorrow. I'll take you guys for lamb soup."

Li Yulin shouted angrily, "At death's door, and you still dare to bribe us!"

"Exactly! You think we're short on a bowl of your lamb soup?" Xu Haibo aided the tyrant.

Chen Guiliang raised the bid, "Two meals! Two meals of lamb soup."

"Now that's more like it." Li Yulin released Chen Guiliang's leg.

Yang Cong let go of the other leg, "No backing out."

Chen Guiliang seized the chance to break free from their grip on his arms, completely regaining his freedom. He said, half-jokingly, half-seriously, "I am pursuing Bian Guanyue, but nothing's happened yet."

The group crowded around Chen Guiliang, sitting him down on the edge of the bed. Those who couldn't grab a spot dragged over stools.

They surrounded him, curiously prying about the situation between him and Bian Guanyue.

Xie Yang interrogated him, "Bian Guanyue never says more than three words in a sentence, and she's cold to everyone. Why would she listen to music with you?"

"I went with her to get her computer fixed," Chen Guiliang explained.

Yang Cong didn't believe him, "Is it that simple?"

Chen Guiliang retorted, "How complicated could it be?"

Xie Yang was full of regret, "I f*cking should have skipped class to go with her. Wasted a golden opportunity!"

Xu Haibo reminded him, "Xie Saobang, Bian Guanyue is our sister-in-law now. You're not allowed to have any ideas about her."

"Fine, I'll go after Zhou Jing then," Xie Yang voluntarily backed out.

Liu Zhihong asked curiously, "Chen Daxia, do you know what Bian Guanyue's family does? Her phone and MP3 player are so expensive."

"No idea," Chen Guiliang shook his head.

After they had finished their rowdy fun with him, the lights in the dorm suddenly went out. The dorm supervisor shouted for them to sleep from the hallway outside.

They each went back to their bunks and took off their clothes, but the topic was open, and they were too worked up to sleep tonight.

Thus, the "pillow talk" session began.

"Li Yulin, how are things going with you and Wang Yu?"

"How else? We go on dates by the man-made lake after evening self-study."

"I meant, have you two... you know."

"No, just hugging and kissing."

"What's it like, kissing a girl?"

"Yeah, hurry up and tell us. You're the only one in the whole dorm who's in a relationship."

"Hmm... I don't know how to describe it, but it feels really good."

"I'm thinking about Ou Yafei from the class next door. That girl is so damn flirty. She wears makeup every day, and her clothes in the summer are really revealing."

"Xu Haibo, which girl do you have a crush on?"

"I don't have a crush on anyone. I'm going to study hard and get a girlfriend in university."

"Bullshit, you definitely do. Spill it. You have a crush on Wu Meng, don't you?"

"Damn, how did you know?"

"The way you f*cking look at Wu Meng is a dead giveaway."

"..."

In the darkness, Chen Guiliang listened silently to his roommates' conversation with a smile on his face.

Though the topics were a bit crude, they were brimming with the beautiful fantasies of youth.

"Chen Guiliang, any news on the New Concept Writing Competition?" Xie Yang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's still early. With hundreds of thousands of submissions, it'll keep the organizers busy for a month or two."

Xu Haibo, however, expressed his confusion, "Chen Daxia, why were you asking me such simple math questions during evening self-study today?"

"My foundation from the first year is weak," Chen Guiliang answered perfunctorily.

Xie Yang exposed him, "You son of a bitch, you almost got a perfect score in math on the arts and sciences stream placement exam. And you're telling me your first-year math foundation is weak?"

Chen Guiliang changed the subject, "Xie Saobang, did you sneak off to the internet cafe?"

"That's right, you piece of shit," Xu Haibo also remembered.

Xie Yang rolled over to face the wall, "I'm sleeping. You guys can chat."

Li Yulin, owner of the broken guitar, suddenly started wailing a song by Beyond, complete with his own damn electronic vibrato, "Steel wok, with tears cryin' fix the wok, broken and chipped ones get a new pot..."

"What are you wailing for? Hurry up and sleep!"

The dorm supervisor's reprimand came from outside the door.

--

(Pleading for guaranteed monthly tickets.)
